claims.content: The Non-C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request Initial Word from a Controlling Unit.

trigger.raw_text: The Non-C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request Initial Word from a Controlling Unit.

claims.content: The Non-C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request Initial Word.
The Non-C2 JU sends a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing its own Track Number and appropriate JU Platform and System Status messages.

If the Controlling Unit requests specific track data by setting the Action, Data Update Request field to value 0, 5, or 6, the Non-C2 JU responds with the requested surveillance information in a J3.4 message.
If the Controlling Unit requests that the Non-C2 JU respond to all subsequent J3.4 messages it transmits, the Non-C2 JU shall transmit all future J3.4 messages to that Controlling Unit.
The Non-C2 JU has successfully transmitted its own Track Number and appropriate JU Platform and System Status messages to the Controlling Unit.
If the Action field in the request indicated a specific data query (values 0, 5, or 6), the Non-C2 JU has transmitted the corresponding surveillance information in a J3.4 message.
If the Action field in the request indicated a subscription to all future data (value 1), the Non-C2 JU is now transmitting all subsequent J3.4 messages to the requesting Controlling Unit.
